title: Copy a local file to a remote computer
summary: Use scp to securely copy a file from your computer to another computer over the network. This works like copying a file, but it sends it to a remote server using SSH.
prerequisites: SSH access to the remote host
Know the remote host address and path

steps.explain: Copy the specified local file to the remote host at the given path.

placeholders.name: LOCAL_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file on your computer

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: Hostname or IP of the remote computer

placeholders.name: REMOTE_FILE
placeholders.description: Destination path on the remote computer
